SCE.S:3CD054: From Sicily. Drifted here while roaming the world as a hippie. Lives by the sea with his girlfriend.
SCE.S:3CD120: Born in Milan. Came to work here via manager Luigi. A first-class cook; pizza is his forte.
SCE.S:3CD1EC: Grad student at the west university, in Italian art history. Eats lunch here to practice Italian.
SCE.S:3CD2B8: Joined the mining firm out of high school. Even in decline, working here helps marriage prospects.
SCE.S:3D6B28: Welcome! Just one? Take any seat you like.
SCE.S:3D6CD8: {6}Yahoo! I'm about to get my hands on some prime meat!
SCE.S:3D6D98: Please stay out of the kitchen.
SCE.S:3D7594: Try our pizza! It's the best!
SCE.S:3D76A4: {6}The lasagna here is delicious. Why don't you join the filling?
SCE.S:3D9B28: Welcome! Just one? Take any seat you like.
SCE.S:3D9CD8: Please stay out of the kitchen.
SCE.S:3DA540: I rushed back from Italy, but the town was in terrible shape.
SCE.S:3DCC2C: {6}You're new, aren't you. You'd better not make a scene.
SCE.S:3DCCB4: {6}How was it? You can enjoy taste here, too.
SCE.S:3DD294: {6}The sense of deliciousness is still strong in you, isn't it?
SCE.S:3DD324: {6}I'm going back to Italy soon. With "humans," of course.
SCE.S:3DD3C0: {6}My sense of taste has become very sharp. What was I eating before?
